definitions.explanation: Footwear worn to protect and comfort the feet. A general term for shoes of all types.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}を{脱|ぬ}いでください。
{新|あたら}しい{靴|くつ}を{買|か}いました。
この{靴|くつ}は{小|ちい}さいです。

notes:
Counter: {足|そく} ({一|いっ}{足|そく}, one pair). Uses {履|は}く (to put on) and {脱|ぬ}ぐ (to take off). In Japan, shoes are removed when entering homes, schools, and many traditional establishments.

Related: {靴下|くつした} (socks).
